title: Mixed Event — Musical Twilight Parade — Episode2 Crossing Paths

meta.Event Outline: Shiho has been scouted by a band that's ready to make its big debut, giving her a lot to think about. Then, Saki invites her on a visit to Phoenix Wonderland. Meanwhile, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS make their own preparations, eager to host them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Wow, that was incredible☆
My heart's racing after hearing that♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for roping you into my practice, Rin.
I know you just planned on visiting...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I really, really, really LOVE singing with you, Nene☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Then can you stay for one more song?
I want to practice for a little bit more...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Of course♪ Put a smile on that face and make my heart race..!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe, thank you.
I'll start now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I had a lot of fun today, everyone!
See you in school!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The band's growing little by little because everyone's working so hard together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I have to go to work now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho continues to play the bass at work even after we're done practicing...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I have to keep practicing too...
Especially if I want to reach her level.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But how do I do that exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(She's so good, but it's not just that.
Her voice is so delicate, gentle and free.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wish I could sing like that...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No! She ran off...
Did I scare her...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But she was so good...
I was hoping to ask how I could sing like her...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I hope I can meet her again...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What's wrong, Saki?
You seem more tired than usual...
Wait! Are you feeling unwell?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, I'm totally fine!
I was just tired from band practice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, good. I'm glad you're so enthusiastic about practicing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But even the most brilliant of prodigies need an occasional break to refresh themselves, so that they can reach their fullest potential!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Speaking of which, you can have this...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Special complimentary tickets from Phoenix Wonderland. I just happened to receive four of them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why don't you drop by with everyone this weekend? Come watch our show and go home with the biggest smiles on your faces!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow... Thanks a bunch!
I'm sure the girls would love this!
We haven't been to PXL in ages!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We'll be there to watch your show for sure!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Listen up, everyone!
We're going to PXL together this weekend!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa gave me enough tickets for all of us!
We used to go when we were little, remember?
I thought it'd be a nice break from practicing too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...!
Yes, I would love to go.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We've all been so tired from practice lately. Maybe this is just the thing we need to make our performances even better!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's true...
I'm for it too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'll pass. I want to practice.
You three go on ahead without me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Did you know that if you go now, they'll be selling limited edition Phenny Penguin merch?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And we might even be able to shake hands with Poochie since Tsukasa works there! How can you say no to that?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'll practice like crazy after!
Like, really, really hard! I mean it!
So much that even you'll be surprised!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So please... Can we go together?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I already turned her down once because I had something to do...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, fine.
I've been after that special Phenny Penguin so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! This is gonna be awesome!
